title: 塞尔达传说：时之笛
en: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
creator: Nintendo EAD
note: 把锁定视角、目标导向探索与『时之笛』的时间解谜编织成被反复临摹数十年的动作冒险语法。
noteEn: Wove lock-on combat, goal-driven exploration and a time-traveling ocarina into the action-adventure grammar still copied today.

title: 塞尔达传说：梅祖拉的假面
en: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
creator: Nintendo EAD
note: 三天循环倒计时让每个抉择都带代价，是系列里最黑暗、也最懂『时间』的一作。
noteEn: A three-day groundhog loop turns every choice into a sacrifice — the series' darkest meditation on time.

title: 塞尔达传说：旷野之息
en: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
creator: Nintendo EPD
note: 把『好奇心即攻略』推向极致：爬山、滑翔与物理相互作用取代了路标，玩家自己书写路线。
noteEn: Championed curiosity-as-guide: climbing, gliding and physics interactions replace waypoints, letting players write their own routes.

title: 塞尔达传说：王国之泪
en: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
creator: Nintendo EPD
note: 在旷野之息的地基上抛出『究极手』合成系统，把整个世界变成可拆装、可组装的巨型道具箱。
noteEn: Adds the Ultrahand build system to BotW's world, turning the entire map into a kit of detachable, buildable parts.

title: 银河战士 Prime
creator: Retro Studios
note: 第一人称把萨姆斯的孤独与异星恐惧装进扫描面甲与护甲界面，是 2D 银河城转向 3D 的教科书。
noteEn: First-person immersion wraps Samus' solitude in scan visors and suit readouts — the textbook 2D-to-3D Metroidvania.

title: 神秘海域2：纵横贼道
creator: Naughty Dog
note: 把电影式过场与攀爬枪战无缝衔接，火车与藏地雪山的场面调度至今仍是第三人称动作的标杆。
noteEn: Seamless set-piece cinema — trains and Himalayan chases — still the benchmark for third-person spectacle.

title: 神秘海域4：盗贼末路
creator: Naughty Dog
note: 兄弟情与盗墓史的纠缠给了德雷克一个体面的退场，钩索与载具把线性关卡玩出开放感。
noteEn: A brother's return gives Drake a dignified exit, while rope-swinging and vehicles widen the linear stages into openness.

title: 最后生还者
creator: Naughty Dog
note: 把僵尸末世写成一部公路片，乔尔与艾莉的关系弧线比感染本身更致命。
noteEn: A zombie apocalypse told as a road movie — Joel and Ellie's bond cuts deeper than the infection.

title: 最后生还者 第二部
en: The Last of Us Part II
creator: Naughty Dog
note: 用双主角视角逼你重审仇恨，艾比的出拳与艾莉的收刀同样沉重，复仇叙事由此反转。
noteEn: Dual protagonists force you to re-litigate revenge — Abby's blows and Ellie's retreat weigh equally.

title: 战神（2018）
creator: Santa Monica Studio
note: 把希腊战神塞进北欧神话与父子关系，一镜到底的镜头把斧头投掷玩成了抒情。
noteEn: A Greek god remade for Norse myth and fatherhood, with a single-shot camera making the axe throw lyrical.

title: 战神：诸神黄昏
creator: Santa Monica Studio
note: 九界地图更立体、剧情锤点更重，阿特柔斯的成年礼与诸神黄昏同步降临。
noteEn: A more vertical Nine Realms and heavier emotional beats — Atreus' coming of age rides on Ragnarök's arrival.

title: 旺达与巨像
creator: Team Ico
note: 去掉杂兵与小怪，十六场与巨像的一对一对话就是全部，空寂草原回响着『为谁而战』。
noteEn: Strips away minor enemies: sixteen one-on-one duels with colossi on an empty plain — the whole game asks for whom you fight.

title: 古堡迷踪
creator: Team Ico
note: 牵手系统把陪伴做成核心玩法，没有血条与菜单，却让逃生路每一步都像告别。
noteEn: Holding hands as core gameplay — no health bars, no menus, yet every step of escape feels like farewell.

title: 大神
creator: Clover Studio
note: 以水墨笔触挥毫解谜与战斗，把日本神话装进一卷会呼吸的浮世绘，天照的画笔至今无二。
noteEn: Brush-stroke puzzles and combat painted in sumi-e ink — Japanese myth in a breathing ukiyo-e scroll.

title: 蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆疯人院
creator: Rocksteady Studios
note: 『侦探视觉』与斯巴达式潜行把蝙蝠侠还原成黑夜中的猎手，疯人院本身就是会说话的迷宫。
noteEn: Detective vision and predator stealth make Batman a hunter in the dark — the asylum itself is a talking maze.

title: 蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆之城
creator: Rocksteady Studios
note: 把疯人院扩成一座露天监狱城，空中滑翔与全息案件档案让哥谭第一次有了实体。
noteEn: Expands the asylum into an open-air prison city — gliding and holographic case files give Gotham physical weight.

title: 只狼：影逝二度
creator: FromSoftware
note: 以『架势』取代血条、以弹反定胜负，把剑戟决斗还原成节奏与呼吸的博弈。
noteEn: Posture replaces health bars — deflection decides duels, reducing sword fights to rhythm and breath.

title: 波斯王子：时之砂
en: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
creator: Ubisoft Montreal
note: 时间倒带让失误变成创作素材，王子与公主的插科打诨让波斯宫廷有了人气。
noteEn: Rewind turns mistakes into material; the prince and princess' banter gives the Persian court real warmth.

title: 超越善恶
creator: Ubisoft
note: 摄影记者打游击、偷拍与地下电台揭露谎言，反乌托邦寓言嵌在明亮的童话外壳里。
noteEn: A photojournalist runs an underground newsroom against a police state — a dystopian fable in bright cartoon clothes.

title: 鬼泣
creator: Capcom
note: 把『风格即难度』做成华丽连招秀，红墓城塔为动作游戏立下了技术标尺。
noteEn: Style-based combos made skill the difficulty — the game that set the bar for spectacle action.

title: 生化危机4
creator: Capcom
note: 过肩视角与体术击打把生存恐怖改写成动作射击，村庄一役定义了新世代的枪战节奏。
noteEn: Over-the-shoulder aim and suplexes turned survival horror into action — the village fight redefined shooter rhythm.

title: 刺客信条2
creator: Ubisoft Montreal
note: 文艺复兴的佛罗伦萨与威尼斯成了跑酷舞台，埃齐奥的成长线让刺客信条有了灵魂。
noteEn: Renaissance Florence and Venice as parkour arenas — Ezio's arc gave Assassin's Creed its soul.

title: 对马岛之魂
creator: Sucker Punch Productions
note: 对马岛的俳句、风引与决斗姿态让武士片活了过来，黑白模式『黑泽』是献给电影的情书。
noteEn: Haiku, wind-guided travel and duel stances revive the chanbara film — the Kurosawa mode is a love letter to cinema.

title: 古墓丽影（2013）
creator: Crystal Dynamics
note: 用求生与攀爬重启劳拉，从温室少女到独当一面的成长写得比机关更动人。
noteEn: Survival and climbing reboot Lara — her arc from green girl to survivor outshines the traps.

title: 地平线：零之曙光
creator: Guerrilla Games
note: 机械恐龙与部落图腾交错，用考古叙事揭开文明崩坏的真相，阿洛伊是近十年最有说服力的新英雄。
noteEn: Machine-dinosaurs meet tribal totems; archaeology-driven lore explains the fall — Aloy is the decade's most credible new hero.

title: 猎天使魔女
creator: PlatinumGames
note: 以舞步编排枪术与召唤，贝优妮塔的夸张姿态把动作游戏做成了一场午夜嘉年华。
noteEn: Dance-choreographed gunplay and demon summons — Bayonetta turns action into a midnight carnival.

title: 合金装备
creator: Konami (Kojima Productions)
note: 躲过摄像头与脚步声、靠剧情过场推进的战术谍报，是潜入玩法与电影叙事的合流点。
noteEn: Camera-dodging, footstep-aware stealth driven by cinema — the confluence of infiltration and filmic storytelling.

title: 最终幻想7
creator: Square
note: 魔晄都市米德加与克劳德的记忆拼图，让 JRPG 第一次认真谈起了身份与生态。
noteEn: Midgar and Cloud's fractured memory gave JRPGs their first serious take on identity and ecology.

title: 最终幻想6
creator: Square
note: 十四名角色的群像在帝国崩溃后各寻出路，魔大战的悲剧底色让『希望』有了分量。
noteEn: Fourteen party members search for purpose after an empire falls — tragedy gives every hope real weight.

title: 时空之轮
creator: Square
note: 穿越纪元、多结局与『新游戏+』，在 16 位机上做出了后来所有时间旅行 RPG 的样板。
noteEn: Era-hopping, multiple endings and New Game+ — the template every time-travel RPG still follows.

title: 时空之轮 2
creator: Square
note: 六十余角色与平行世界的叙事野心，配以光田康典的竖琴与钢琴，是续作中罕见的艺术冒险。
noteEn: Sixty-plus characters across parallel worlds, scored by Mitsuda's harp — a sequel that dared to be art.

title: 最终幻想10
creator: Square
note: 泰达对斯彼拉的陌生眼光就是玩家的眼光，尤娜的旅程以『反抗宿命』收束成泪水。
noteEn: Tidus' outsider gaze is the player's; Yuna's pilgrimage ends in tears against a scripted fate.

title: 地球冒险
creator: Ape & HAL Laboratory
note: 把美式小镇日常放进 RPG，电话存档与 PSI 让『战斗』第一次可以谈判与和解。
noteEn: American small-town life inside an RPG — telephones for saving, PSI powers that make battles negotiable.

title: 女神异闻录5 皇家版
creator: Atlus
note: 怪盗团在东京的日常与宫殿双线并进，视觉与爵士配乐把高中生造反写成风格宣言。
noteEn: Tokyo's daily life runs parallel to Palace heists; style and jazz turn teenage rebellion into a manifesto.

title: 巫师3：狂猎
creator: CD Projekt Red
note: 猎魔人的支线没有对错只有代价，血腥男爵的故事证明 RPG 的良心藏在字里行间。
noteEn: Side quests with no right answers, only costs — the Bloody Baron proves an RPG's conscience lives in its writing.

title: 艾尔登法环
creator: FromSoftware
note: 无缝开放世界与魂系硬核咬合，骑马、骨灰与战灰让受苦变成一种可以被分享的朝圣。
noteEn: Open world fused with Souls difficulty — Torrent, spirit ashes and ashes' arts turn suffering into shared pilgrimage.

title: 黑暗之魂
creator: FromSoftware
note: 以地图咬合与信息碎片撑起难度，死亡不是惩罚而是世界运转的语法。
noteEn: Interlocking maps and cryptic lore underpin the difficulty — death is not punishment but the world's grammar.

title: 黑暗之魂3
creator: FromSoftware
note: 把前两代的武器与地图做了终曲式缝合，灰烬的余火在薪王传说里烧到最后。
noteEn: A finale suturing the first two games' gear and vistas — the Ashen One carries the embers to the end.

title: 血源诅咒
creator: FromSoftware
note: 维多利亚哥特与克苏鲁畸变咬合，锯肉刀与内脏暴击鼓励以攻代守的近身狂舞。
noteEn: Victorian gothic meets Lovecraftian horror — sawblades and visceral attacks reward aggressive, close-range dancing.

title: 质量效应
creator: BioWare
note: 把太空歌剧装进对话轮，谢泼德的选择在星系尺度的道德光谱上不断回响。
noteEn: Space opera via a dialogue wheel — Shepard's choices ripple across a galactic moral spectrum.

title: 质量效应2
creator: BioWare
note: 以『忠诚任务』做角色驱动，自杀任务的倒计时让每段羁绊都可能在终点前断裂。
noteEn: Loyalty missions make it character-driven — the suicide run's countdown can sever any bond before the end.

title: 龙腾世纪：起源
creator: BioWare
note: 六种起源开场与战术 AI 编程，把《博德之门》的血统推进了实时暂停的新世代。
noteEn: Six origin stories and tactical AI scripting carry Baldur's Gate's lineage into the real-time-with-pause era.

title: 博德之门3
creator: Larian Studios
note: 骰子、环境互动与自由杀生的密度，让桌面规则在电脑上第一次有了呼吸感。
noteEn: Dice rolls, environmental trickery and goblin-killing freedom let tabletop rules breathe on PC for the first time.

title: 上古卷轴5：天际
creator: Bethesda Game Studios
note: 龙吼与天际省的山谷雪原把『随便往哪走都有事做』变成了一种世界观而非功能。
noteEn: Dragon shouts and snowy valleys made 'go anywhere, find something' a worldview rather than a feature.

title: 上古卷轴3：晨风
creator: Bethesda Game Studios
note: 没有任务箭头、只有文字日记，瓦登费尔的怪异生态逼玩家真正学会读地图。
noteEn: No quest markers, only a written journal — Vvardenfell's alien ecology forces you to actually read the map.

title: 辐射：新维加斯
creator: Obsidian Entertainment
note: 莫哈维废土的阵营之间没有纯善，凯撒军团与 NCR 的选择把冷战宿命塞进点 44 口径。
noteEn: No clean side in the Mojave — Caesar's Legion vs. the NCR stuffs Cold War destiny into .44 rounds.

title: 辐射4
creator: Bethesda Game Studios
note: 定居点建造与动力甲改装让废土变成可经营的沙盘，『义勇军将军』是带着锤子的幻想。
noteEn: Settlement building and power-armor mods turn the wasteland into a sandbox you can run with a hammer.

title: 神界：原罪2
creator: Larian Studios
note: 元素地表与物理环境互相点火，行动自由到连 NPC 都可以是经验值——或是队友。
noteEn: Elemental surfaces and physics interplay; freedom so total that NPCs can be XP — or party members.

title: 星球大战：旧共和国武士
en: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
creator: BioWare
note: 原力、光剑与抉择，加上后期反转的身份谜底，是星战故事在 RPG 里的最佳形态。
noteEn: The Force, sabers and choices — capped by a mid-game identity twist — Star Wars' finest RPG form.

title: 传说之下
creator: Toby Fox
note: 用『不杀』当作通关选项，把战斗的暴力循环反过来质问玩家，像素底下全是规则。
noteEn: Mercy as a victory condition turns the violence loop back on the player — beneath the pixels, pure rules.

title: 宝可梦 红／绿
creator: Game Freak
note: 捕捉、培育与交换让收集本身成为叙事，151 只宝可梦是几代人共享的童年词表。
noteEn: Catch, train, trade — collection becomes narrative; 151 creatures form a shared childhood vocabulary.

title: 勇者斗恶龙11
creator: Square Enix (Armor Project)
note: 鸟山明人设与椙山浩一的交响乐，把王道 RPG 的『确定感』打磨成安心与感动。
noteEn: Toriyama's art and Sugiyama's symphonies polish the comfort of a classic JRPG into pure reassurance.

title: 尼尔：机械纪元
creator: PlatinumGames
note: 2B 的视角在 2D、弹幕与砍杀间切换，多周目结局用『删除存档』逼你直面意义。
noteEn: 2B's view shifts between 2D, bullet-hell and slashing; the finale asks you to delete your save to mean it.

title: 如龙0
creator: Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio
note: 神室町的烟火气与八十年代泡沫经济，让街头打架和小游戏都成了庶民史诗。
noteEn: Kamurocho's neon bustle and the bubble economy make street brawls and minigames into an everyman epic.

title: 异度神剑
creator: Monolith Soft
note: 站在两具巨神身上看世界的科幻神话，自动战斗与广阔地图是新一代 JRPG 的宣言。
noteEn: A world staged on two sleeping titans — auto-attacks and a vast map declare the next-gen JRPG.

title: 异域镇魂曲
creator: Black Isle Studios
note: 文字量堪比小说，与『无名氏』的对话如同哲学论辩，证明 RPG 可以只靠文本抵达深渊。
noteEn: Novel-length prose and dialogue as philosophy — proof an RPG can reach the abyss with text alone.

title: 暗黑破坏神2
creator: Blizzard North
note: 随机地图、符文之语与刷宝循环，定义了 ARPG『再来一把』的诅咒，直到今天。
noteEn: Random maps, runewords and loot loops defined the 'one more run' curse that still rules ARPGs.

title: 侠盗猎车手3
creator: DMA Design
note: 自由城的三维街道首次允许『想去哪就去哪』，汽车与暴力从此成为开放世界的模板。
noteEn: Liberty City's 3D streets first let you go anywhere — cars and chaos became the open-world template.

title: 侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯
creator: Rockstar North
note: 三座城市与荒野、帮派地盘与健身系统，把开放世界的规模从街区扩大到生活方式。
noteEn: Three cities, gang turf and a gym system grew the open world from blocks to a lifestyle.

title: 侠盗猎车手4
creator: Rockstar North
note: 自由城被湿漉漉的写实压得喘不过气，物理与人际把黑帮叙事拉回地面。
noteEn: A rain-soaked, crushingly realistic Liberty City grounds the mob story in physics and human frailty.

title: 侠盗猎车手5
creator: Rockstar North
note: 三位主角的切人与合流让抢劫不再是任务而是编排，洛圣都的讽刺光谱亮到刺眼。
noteEn: Three protagonists and heists as choreography — Los Santos' satire is bright enough to sting.

title: 荒野大镖客：救赎
creator: Rockstar San Diego
note: 荒野西部的黄昏，马背上的长镜头与约翰·马斯顿的还债之旅是工业时代的挽歌。
noteEn: The Old West at dusk — horseback long shots and Marston's debt-paying ride are an elegy for an industrial age.

title: 荒野大镖客：救赎2
creator: Rockstar Games
note: 营地兄弟情与马匹毛发的物理细节，把西部开放世界做成一件能触摸的标本。
noteEn: Camp brotherhood and horse-grooming physics make the frontier an open world you can touch.

title: 莎木
creator: Sega AM2
note: 1999 年的横须贺有天气、工作与街机厅，铃木裕用预算把『生活感』浇灌成开放世界前史。
noteEn: 1999 Yokosuka with weather, jobs and an arcade — Yu Suzuki's budget made everyday life the proto-open-world.

title: 热血无赖
creator: United Front Games
note: 香港霓虹与功夫擒拿，警匪卧底戏在雨夜街巷里打出一套硬桥硬马。
noteEn: Hong Kong neon and kung-fu takedowns — an undercover cop drama staged in rain-slick alleys.

title: 恶霸鲁尼
creator: Rockstar Vancouver
note: 校园版 GTA，恶作剧、翘课与老师巡逻把青春期的压迫感做成开放世界喜剧。
noteEn: GTA set in a school — pranks, skipping class and teacher patrols turn teen pressure into open-world comedy.

title: 孤岛惊魂3
creator: Ubisoft Montreal
note: 瓦斯的丛林与反派 Vaas 的疯言疯语，让『信号塔开图』从此成了开放世界标配。
noteEn: Rook Island's jungle and Vaas's madness made radio-tower map-unlocking a genre default.

title: 看门狗
creator: Ubisoft Montreal
note: 芝加哥的摄像头与手机入侵，把整座城市变成可破解的界面，是黑客视角开放世界的先行者。
noteEn: Chicago's CCTV and phone-hacking render the whole city as a hackable interface — the hacker's open world, first try.

title: 赛博朋克2077
creator: CD Projekt Red
note: 夜之城的霓虹密度无出其右，历经修葺与《往日之影》后，它终于兑现了『赛博朋克』的承诺。
noteEn: Night City's neon density is unmatched; after patches and Phantom Liberty, it finally keeps its cyberpunk promise.

title: 刺客信条：奥德赛
creator: Ubisoft Quebec
note: 古希腊的每座山都藏着一个神话，育碧把历史旅游做成了刺客信条的招牌。
noteEn: Every Greek peak hides a myth — Ubisoft turned historical tourism into Assassin's Creed's calling card.

title: 地平线：西之绝境
creator: Guerrilla Games
note: 旧金山废墟与热带雨林同框，飞行坐骑把地平线的垂直探索带上新高度。
noteEn: San Francisco ruins beside rainforests — a flying mount lifts Horizon's vertical exploration to new heights.

title: 漫威蜘蛛侠
creator: Insomniac Games
note: 蛛网摆荡的物理手感是曼哈顿的通行证，漫画式演出让超级英雄第一次有了体重。
noteEn: Web-swinging physics is the ticket to Manhattan; comic-book beats give a superhero real gravity.

title: 死亡搁浅
creator: Kojima Productions
note: 把『送快递』做成连接主义寓言，山峦与雨雪让每一步负重都有意义，是反暴力开放世界的宣言。
noteEn: Package delivery as a connectivity fable — every loaded step through rain and rock matters; an anti-violent open world.

title: 无人深空
creator: Hello Games
note: 一亿八千万颗星球程序生成，从发售翻车到八年补全，是『承诺』与『救赎』并存的活标本。
noteEn: 18 quintillion procedural planets, from launch disaster to eight years of updates — a living monument to redemption.

title: 声名狼藉：次子
creator: Sucker Punch Productions
note: 西雅图的霓虹与烟尘，善与恶两套超能力树让『选择』有了看得见的后果。
noteEn: Neon Seattle where karmic power trees make every choice visibly reshape the city.

title: 原神
creator: miHoYo
note: 把开放世界搬上手机并做成长线更新，提瓦特的七国地图与抽卡范式改写了大作的下沉方式。
noteEn: Open world on phones with a live-service cadence — Teyvat's map and gacha model rewrote how big games reach everyone.

title: 超级马力欧兄弟
creator: Nintendo R&D4
note: 顶砖、跳踩与秘密通道定义了平台跳跃的基本语汇，1985 年的 1-1 关是一代人的集体记忆。
noteEn: Brick-smashing, stomping and secrets defined the platformer's vocabulary — level 1-1 is a shared childhood.

title: 超级马力欧兄弟3
creator: Nintendo R&D4
note: 变身、地图关卡与道具箱把马力欧从一关游戏升级成一场远征，是 8 位机的结构巅峰。
noteEn: Power-ups, an overworld map and item boxes turned Mario into an expedition — the NES's structural peak.

title: 超级马力欧世界
creator: Nintendo EAD
note: 耀西、开关与幽灵屋的机关密度，加上存档与隐藏出口，是 16 位平台跳跃的完整体。
noteEn: Yoshi, switches and ghost-house tricks plus save files and secret exits — the 16-bit platformer complete.

title: 索尼克
creator: Sonic Team
note: 速度与环的物理，绿山区的卷轴滚动让『跑』第一次成为快感本身。
noteEn: Speed and ring physics — Green Hill's scrolling made running the pleasure itself.

title: 大金刚国度
creator: Rare
note: 预渲染 3D 建模转 2D 的画面革命，配合 Rare 的关卡密度，是 90 年代初的技术宣言。
noteEn: Pre-rendered 3D sprites and Rare's dense level design — the early-90s technical manifesto.

title: 超级马力欧64
creator: Nintendo EAD
note: 三维摇杆让马力欧第一次真正『跳』进空间，桃花公主城堡的开放式关卡是 3D 平台跳跃的源点。
noteEn: An analog stick put Mario truly in 3D — Peach's castle's open hub is the origin of the 3D platformer.

title: 超级马力欧银河
creator: Nintendo EAD
note: 引力把平台铺成球形，管弦乐与宫本茂的『重力』实验让每一关都像微型太阳系。
noteEn: Gravity bends platforms into spheres; orchestral scores and Miyamoto's experiments make each level a tiny solar system.

title: 超级马力欧银河2
creator: Nintendo EAD
note: 把一代的奇想浓缩成更密、更硬的核心关卡，耀西加入后连行星都能骑。
noteEn: Distills the first game's wonder into denser, harder core levels — and you can ride Yoshi on planets.

title: 超级食肉男孩
creator: Team Meat
note: 毫秒级的操作精度与上千条即死关卡，把『再来一次』从沮丧变成信仰。
noteEn: Frame-perfect controls and thousands of one-hit stages turn 'one more try' from frustration into faith.

title: 雷曼：传奇
creator: Ubisoft Montpellier
note: 手绘关卡与音乐节奏关的同步演出，多人接力让这场水彩冒险像乐队合奏。
noteEn: Hand-drawn stages and rhythm levels synced to music — co-op makes the watercolor romp play like a band.

title: 铲子骑士
creator: Yacht Club Games
note: 铲子骑士把 NES 时代的撑杆跳、场景道具与 8 位作曲做成一封精装情书。
noteEn: Shovel Knight packages NES-era pogo, stage gimmicks and chiptune into a deluxe love letter.

title: 奥日与黑暗森林
creator: Moon Studios
note: 塞尔达式的技能成长配上手绘森林与催泪开场，把银河城做成一首长镜头诗。
noteEn: Metroidvania growth, hand-painted forest and a gut-punch prologue — the genre as a long-take poem.

title: 茶杯头
creator: Studio MDHR
note: 1930 年代橡皮管动画的逐帧手绘，Boss 战硬核到像在给老动画配音。
noteEn: Frame-by-frame 1930s rubber-hose animation; bosses so hard they feel like dubbing a vintage cartoon.

title: 蔚蓝
creator: Maddy Makes Games
note: 把登山的挫败感写进『协助模式』与剧情，玛德琳的焦虑和玩家的手柄一起深呼吸。
noteEn: It builds the climb's frustration into its assist mode and story — Madeline's anxiety breathes with your controller.

title: 空洞骑士
creator: Team Cherry
note: 圣巢的地下遗迹层层咬合，手绘虫族与晦暗叙事让银河城的探索带上了考古味。
noteEn: Hallownest's underground interlock, hand-drawn bugs and cryptic lore turn exploration into archaeology.

title: 索尼克狂热
creator: Headcannon & PagodaWest Games
note: 老粉丝手作的新关卡把 2D 索尼克的速度哲学复活，是官方重拾初心的最好示范。
noteEn: Fan-made new zones revive 2D Sonic's speed philosophy — proof the franchise's heart was never lost.

title: 超级马力欧：奥德赛
creator: Nintendo EPD
note: 附身系统让每个敌人都是新玩具，全球各地的王国与月亮收集把开放探索装进箱庭。
noteEn: Capturing enemies turns everyone into a toy; worldwide kingdoms and moons pack open exploration into dioramas.

title: 奥日与萤火意志
en: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
creator: Moon Studios
note: 灰烬森林的机关密度与大型 Boss 战补齐了系列短板，两作并看才是完整叙事。
noteEn: Denser challenges and real bosses fill the gaps of the first — together the two make a complete arc.

title: 双人成行
creator: Hazelight Studios
note: 双人分屏强制协作，每关换一套玩法，把『关系修复』的主题做成了关卡本身。
noteEn: Forced co-op with a new mechanic every level — the theme of mending a relationship becomes the level design.

title: 宇宙机器人
creator: Team Asobi
note: 把 PS5 手柄的触觉与自适应扳机做成关卡语言，复古致敬关卡的密度高到令人窒息。
noteEn: DualSense haptics and adaptive triggers become level grammar; the nostalgia levels are breathtakingly dense.
